リ ッ ク ・ デ ィ ア ス、 発 進 ！
『機動戦士Ｚガンダム』より、アポリー、ロベルトが搭乗した、リック・ディアスがＨＧシリーズで商品化。
一部外装と関節をアップデートし、特徴的な機体カラーを成形色で再現。
●　リック・ディアスをアップデートし、装甲カラーを成形色で再現
設定画を元に外装など機体各所をアップデート。
アポリー、ロベルトが搭乗した機体カラーを成形色で再現。
●　ダイナミックなポージングが可能

en: Black mass-produced machine "γ (Gamma) Gundam" -
Rick Dear, take off!
From "Mobile Suit Z Gundam", Rick Diaz, piloted by Apoli and Roberto, is commercialized in the HG series.
Some of the exterior and joints have been updated, and the characteristic aircraft color has been reproduced with molded color.
● Updated Rick Diaz and reproduced the armor color with molded color.
Updated various parts of the aircraft, including the exterior, based on the setting image.
The color of the aircraft that Apoli and Roberto boarded is reproduced in molding color.
● Dynamic poses possible
The joint mechanism conforms to the latest HG format, allowing for bold and powerful actions.
Attached weapons: clay bazooka / beam pistol / beam saber
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
